procedure: Frame entity, period, cutoff, framework basis and actual public evidence access.
Freeze originals and trace every material company assertion and numeric observation to source ID and physical PDF page.
Author the learning request without inventing facts or replacing unavailable values with zero.
Use standalone prepare/build/check; retain their observed outputs and limitations.
Arrange independent source, judgment and document review through the host, record findings and re-review changed artifacts.

acceptance.expectation: Validate the actual request against esg-learning-report/1; schema validation does not test cross-record references.
Observe local source hash, ID and physical-page checks; preserve failures and missing files.
Inspect original wording, metric boundary/method/unit, numeric values and cutoff evidence; citations alone do not entail a claim.
Keep unofficial learning status visible; separate analysis from cited company assertions, null from zero, and reconstruction from compliance or assurance.
Record actual independent source, judgment and document reviewers, exact inspected hashes and issue dispositions, or pending/unavailable coverage.
Record actual rendering, page count, visible citations and all-page inspection; HTML-only output is not a PDF pass.

source: Original meaning, source identity/hash, locator, publication timing at cutoff, units, periods, boundary and calculation basis.
judgment: Teaching scope, methodological commentary, counterevidence, material omissions and limits on conclusions; no assurance/compliance claim.
document: Exact current input/HTML/PDF bindings, visible source references, every page, charts/tables, clipping and faithful qualifications.

failure.record: Affected IDs/artifact hashes, missing or failed check, consequence, next action and interim conclusion restriction.
conditions: Unsupported or missing source, dependency or rendering capability.
Stale source/input/output binding, broken citations or failed checks.
Material unresolved findings or unavailable independent review.
